text: install PCS LDS-120V LED Dimming Stabilizer in parallel across the pigtail black(load)/white(neutral) leads to fix TRIAC holding-current dropout — bulb flickers ~20%, cuts out entirely above ~54%. Rejected the Aeotec ZW150 (wrong device: Z-Wave smart-switch parasitic-power bypass, not a resistive bleeder). See hardware.md 'LED dimmer compatibility bleeder'. Breaker off before wiring.
